items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: L.Z. Cooper was in the band first... L.Z. Cooper was in the band at the time, and Papa Mutt, and I can't think who else... me and Ram... walked across there... here come L.Z. Cooper and Papa Mutt

ctx.x: And Ram [Hall] was on the drums with that band?
Yeah, Ram was on drums. L.Z. Cooper played piano.
